items.title: Pilot — Agentic AI Architecture
items.tagline: Production-Grade Multi-Agent Orchestration powering an enterprise EdTech platform in Tunisia
description: Real-time streaming voice agent: LiveKit SFU + Silero VAD with barge-in interruption in <350ms, Deepgram STT streaming, OpenAI TTS.
3-Tier CrewAI multi-agent cluster: Pedagogical Tutor Agent (RAG-grounded) → Fact-Checker Anti-Hallucination Agent → Adaptive Quiz Generator Agent.
Hybrid RAG retrieval: Mathematical scoring function Score = 0.75 × CosineSimilarity + 0.25 × BM25Boost on pgvector with markdown-preserving chunking.
MCP Standardized Tools with Pydantic v2: KnowledgeSearchInput (prompt-injection sanitized), CalendarToolInput, and HandoffToolInput for human-in-the-loop escalation.
Full observability in production: Langfuse distributed tracing (tokens, latency, cost) and Ragas evaluation harness for Faithfulness & Answer Relevance.
achievements: <350ms streaming voice barge-in latency under live network conditions.
Anti-hallucination fact-checking layer eliminating factual drift in tutoring responses.
Prompt-injection sanitized MCP tool schemas designed with Pydantic v2.

items.title: Lessons Learned Smart Application
items.tagline: Industry 4.0 AI Diagnostic Platform automating machine error diagnostics on factory shop floors
description: Multi-strategy CV OCR: Central 50% ROI bounding box, bilateral filtering, adaptive Gaussian thresholding vs. Otsu binarization cascade (confidence >25.0 + industrial regex validation).
Multi-output NLP classifier: TF-IDF + Random Forest MultiOutputClassifier predicting Root Cause AND Corrective Action simultaneously.
Sub-15ms ML inference per prediction — reducing MTTR from 10 minutes of manual lookup to under 5 seconds.
Dual enterprise integration: Interactive Gradio launch from Power Apps + headless JSON API (/api/diagnose) via Power Automate.
achievements: Sub-15ms ML inference deployed on Hugging Face Spaces with Git LFS.
95% accuracy in simultaneous root cause and corrective action predictions.
Reduced shop-floor troubleshooting time from 10 minutes to under 5 seconds.

items.title: Clinic Management System
items.tagline: Production MERN Platform with Multi-Role RBAC, Security Hardening & Full CI/CD
description: Multi-Role RBAC: JWT cookie-auth (sameSite: none), Mongoose discriminator inheritance from single users collection to 3 role models.
Hardened security stack: Helmet headers, express-rate-limit, express-mongo-sanitize, GitHub Actions CodeQL SAST, and Aquasec Trivy scanning.
Full test automation: Jest + Supertest + mongodb-memory-server, React Testing Library, and Cypress E2E (auth, route guards, patient flows).
Production UX: Animated dark mode, zero-dependency bilingual i18n (EN/FR), React ErrorBoundary, and toast notifications.
achievements: Clean CodeQL SAST report and zero critical vulnerabilities on Trivy container scans.
100% test coverage for critical patient registration and prescription flows.
35% administrative overhead reduction through synchronized electronic health records.

items.title: UniStay — Student Housing Platform
items.tagline: Cloud-Native Booking Platform with Elasticsearch 8 & OWASP Top 10 Hardening
description: Elasticsearch 8: French linguistic analyzer, Fuzziness AUTO, geospatial geo_distance campus proximity filtering, and real-time pricing aggregations.
OWASP Top 10 Security: Argon2id/Bcrypt hashing, anti-CSRF/XSS, Anti-IDOR resource policies, and pessimistic DB locking (lockForUpdate) against double-booking race conditions.
Multilingual UI: Seamless trilingual experience with full internationalization.
6-Container orchestration: Nginx + PHP 8.3 FPM + PostgreSQL + Redis + Elasticsearch + Mailpit via Docker Compose.
Code quality: PHPStan Level 8 static analysis and Laravel Pint PSR-12 enforcement.
achievements: Zero PHPStan Level 8 static analysis errors across entire codebase.
Pessimistic database locking guaranteeing zero double-booking collisions.
Sub-50ms fuzzy full-text and geospatial campus proximity search queries.

items.title: NovaMart Platform
items.tagline: Full-Stack E-Commerce Monorepo with Hardened Container CI/CD to GHCR
description: Decoupled monorepo architecture: Customer storefront (Next.js), merchant analytics dashboard, and containerized Express REST API.
Hardened containers: Multi-stage Dockerfile, non-root appuser (UID 1001), automated healthcheck endpoint (/api/health).
Continuous delivery: GitHub Actions CI/CD with automated Docker builds and releases to GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) on every push to main.
Full cart, catalog, and checkout management backed by MongoDB and Vitest tests.
achievements: Automated releases to GHCR on every verified commit to main branch.
Strict non-root container execution conforming to enterprise security baselines.
Sub-millisecond catalog browsing and inventory tracking.

items.title: Facial Emotion Recognition
items.tagline: Real-Time CNN Emotion Detector with Psychological Advice System
description: 7-class emotion detection: Angry, Disgust, Fear, Happy, Neutral, Sad, Surprise — in real-time webcam stream via OpenCV with confidence overlays.
Psychological advice engine: For every detected emotion, dynamic side-panel delivers 3 actionable wellness tips + an inspirational quote.
CNN architecture: 3 Conv2D blocks + BatchNorm + MaxPool + Dropout → Dense(256) → Softmax(7), trained on FER2013 (35,887 grayscale images).
Multi-face support: Haar Cascade detector handling multiple faces simultaneously with independent classification.
achievements: Real-time 30+ FPS inference on standard consumer CPU/GPU hardware.
Empathetic AI interface dedicated to user emotional well-being.
Trained on over 35,000 diverse facial expression benchmark images.
